propositions: Post-rewrite commit SHAs in compacted ledger entries become stale; verifier must resolve positions against current history instead of trusting pre-rewrite stored SHAs.
Ledger entry commit_sha should function as a cache with position-resolved current commit as primary and recorded SHA as fail-closed fallback when position resolution fails.
Real-Git history rewrite regression must prove that a compacted ledger with non-null pre-rewrite SHAs verifies correctly after all reachable commits change and positions resolve to new SHAs.
Live-event commit resolution, ledger wire format, persisted schema, and event bytes must remain unchanged after the fix.
Pre-rewrite and post-rewrite identity verification summaries must yield identical verdict counts and (event_uuid, verdict, grandfathered) multisets when commit SHAs are normalized.
